skills.name: 乱击
skills.officialText: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以将两张手牌当【万箭齐发】使用。其他角色因响应你使用的【万箭齐发】而打出【闪】时，你摸一张牌（每回合你至多以此法获得3张牌）。

skills.name: 血裔
skills.officialText: 主公技，锁定技，你的手牌上限+X（X为其他群势力角色数的两倍）。你使用牌指定其他群势力角色为目标后，你摸一张牌（每回合你至多以此法获得2张牌）。

release.availability: Anniversary limited sale, permanent general acquisition; not a trial-only roster entry.

latestLocatedDescriptionCorrection.result: No Luanji or Xueyi row; no conflicting applicable correction found.

implementationContract: Luanji pays exactly two actual Hand entities with any printed suits; it is one normal native Arrow Barrage use once per native Play. Same-suit versions retain their declared SameSuit policy.

Luanji rewards real other-provider Dodge responses to this owner's Arrow Barrage, including physical Arrow Barrage, not only the conversion. Pure Slash defense, Nullification or another actor's Arrow Barrage does not qualify.

Xueyi uses native Lord/projection qualification and live effective faction population for hand limit. Designation rewards freeze actual other-Qun main targets at native finalization; Borrowed Sword records only its main weapon-holder targets.
Targets newly announced by a native redirect/extension append to the native target window. Acquiring the source inside an earlier target window does not retroactively issue old targets.

Each skill has an independent whole actual-turn counter keyed by named skill and recipient, preserved across source instances. Counters count real native drawn DrawPile-to-Hand entities; a short/empty draw does not burn the missing material quota. Replacement obtained entities retain their existing native replacement semantics and are not relabelled as drawn cards.
The reward uses existing generic native Draw and its own recovery/movement/skill descendants. No custom pending state, parallel use-ID sidecar or detached fake action is introduced.
